content.short: Ripio is a Latin American crypto exchange and wallet for buying, selling and holding digital assets.
content.description: Ripio is one of the longer-running crypto companies in Latin America, offering a centralized exchange alongside the Ripio Wallet for buying, selling and holding digital assets. World's official World Chain ecosystem directory lists both the exchange and the wallet. Latin America is one of the regions where World has concentrated its growth, which makes a regional exchange a natural partner for the network.
content.meta: Ripio is a Latin American crypto exchange and wallet, listed in World's World Chain ecosystem.
